title: Course Module Spec
description: Input spec consumed by the /build-module command of the course-builder plugin. Describes one course module and drives the 12 subagents + 3 skills + 2 hooks that produce the artifact bundle. The `tipo_avaliacao` field selects the module's assessment model: 'repo-bugs' (default) drives a planted-bug coding repo; 'projeto-pitch' drives a group proposal + pitch project (Phase-2 produces a project kit and bug-smith is skipped); 'debate-caso' drives a per-lesson 4-block structure (teoria -> exemplos_basicos -> desafio_real -> debate_grupo) with 7 architectural case scenarios debated in groups per lesson — Phase 2 (repo-scaffolder and bug-smith) is skipped entirely and exercise-author writes case briefs + instructor debate notes directly under aulas/. 'estudo-dirigido' drives expository lessons in which only the instructor demonstrates, one fictional case with an executable kit across every lesson, one single-source Python file per lesson rendered by deterministic generators, and asynchronous practice in a study guide (PDF) plus monitor and interactive guides (skill aula-fonte-unica).

curso.description: The course this module belongs to.

publico_alvo.description: Target audience profile. Free-text, but should be specific enough to drive tone/depth of generated artifacts.

aulas.description: Ordered list of lessons in this module. At least one is required.

topicos.description: Concrete topics the lesson covers. Drives lesson-plan, slides and script generation. Non-empty.

duracao_min.description: Optional lesson duration in minutes. Omit if the module default applies.

modulo.description: Optional module label when one spec covers several modules (e.g. 'M3'). In mode estudo-dirigido it names the lesson id (m3_a1) and folder (M3/aula-1).

modulo_nome.description: Optional full module name shown on materials (e.g. 'M3 · Workflows, agentes, tool use e MCPs').

data.description: Lesson date (YYYY-MM-DD). Required in mode estudo-dirigido.

pergunta.description: The question the lesson answers, in one line. The opening states it and the closing answers it. Required in mode estudo-dirigido.

monitor.description: Topic of the monitor's 20-minute talk in this lesson (mode estudo-dirigido).

casos_debate.description: Exactly 7 architectural debate case scenarios for this lesson's group-discussion block (tipo_avaliacao=debate-caso). Each scenario is assigned to one group. Drives exercise-author's student-facing case briefs and instructor-facing debate notes.

contexto.description: The real-world scenario the group must analyze (system, constraints, stakeholders).

pergunta_arquitetural.description: The architectural decision the group must argue for and justify (e.g. 'workflow determinístico ou agente autônomo para este fluxo, e por quê?').

opcoes.description: The architectural options on the table (e.g. ['workflow determinístico', 'agente autônomo', 'híbrido com HITL']).

tensao_central.description: The core tradeoff driving the decision (custo, latência, controlabilidade, previsibilidade da tarefa, auditabilidade, etc.).

ferramenta_base.description: Base AI tool the module teaches. Pinned version is consumed by bug-smith/qa-reviewer to mitigate tool-rot.

versao.description: Concrete version floor (e.g. '2.1'). Used to scope generated examples and bug-smith behavior.

filosofia.description: Pedagogical contract for the module. Both flags default to true.

artifact_first.description: Every interaction ends in a versionable artifact, never chatbot Q&A.

hitl_so_grave.description: Human-in-the-loop only on grave/risky paths; automate the safe path.

branding.description: Visual/organizational identity for generated artifacts. Optional; when omitted, the orchestrator derives org from curso.nome and uses a default accent color.

cor_acento.description: Hex accent color used in HTML portal and slides.

pesquisar_tendencias.description: Whether the trend-researcher subagent runs. Defaults to true. Set false to skip web research (e.g. offline runs, rate-limited environment).

slide_max.description: Optional hard cap on slides per aula. When present, lesson-planner's Gamma prompt must not exceed it and qa-reviewer flags violations. When absent, lesson-planner falls back to its own time-budget heuristic (which can run to 35-45 slides for a 180min repo-bugs lecture).

estrutura_aula.description: Fixed 4-block in-class pedagogical template — teoria -> exemplos_basicos -> desafio_real -> debate_grupo — applied uniformly to every aula. Required when tipo_avaliacao=debate-caso; ignored otherwise.

blocos.description: Minute budget per block. Should sum to each aula's duracao_min (checked by qa-reviewer, not by this schema).

teoria_min.description: Minutes for the formal-concepts block, framed for architectural decision-making.

exemplos_basicos_min.description: Minutes for basic worked examples illustrating the theory.

desafio_real_min.description: Minutes for the instructor-led walkthrough of a real architectural challenge.

debate_grupo_min.description: Minutes for the 7-scenario group debate plus plenary synthesis.

tipo_avaliacao.description: Assessment model for this module, selecting the Phase-2 behavior. 'repo-bugs' (default): students fix verified planted bugs in a coding repo — Phase 2 runs repo-scaffolder -> bug-smith -> exercise-author, and qa-reviewer re-verifies the bugs. 'projeto-pitch': students deliver an executive proposal + pitch for a real problem — Phase 2 runs repo-scaffolder (project-kit mode) -> exercise-author (project-brief mode), bug-smith is SKIPPED, and qa-reviewer verifies project-kit coherence instead of planted bugs. When 'projeto-pitch', the `projeto` block is required and `ferramenta_base` is not needed. 'debate-caso': every aula follows the 4-block teoria/exemplos_basicos/desafio_real/debate_grupo structure and closes with 7 architectural case scenarios debated in groups — Phase 2 is skipped entirely (no repo-scaffolder, no bug-smith); exercise-author writes case briefs + instructor debate notes directly under aulas/aula-<n>/casos/. When 'debate-caso', `estrutura_aula` is required and every aula must have `casos_debate` with exactly 7 entries. 'estudo-dirigido': expository lessons on a fixed grid (opening and map, five chained concepts, fixed break, two-act demonstration on the case, 20-minute monitor slot, discussion, closing); Phase 2 runs repo-scaffolder (generator kit + repo layout) -> case-kit-builder (executable case kit), bug-smith is SKIPPED, and Phase 3 writes one source per lesson, records real demo runs, writes the study guide, the instructor speech and the interactive guide. When 'estudo-dirigido', `turma`, `caso` and `ferramenta_base` are required and every aula needs `data` and `pergunta`.

turma.description: Class logistics for mode estudo-dirigido: who teaches, when, the fixed break and monitor slots, and the public class repository.

monitor.description: Fixed slot of the monitor's talk in every lesson.

repositorio.description: Public class repository URL that receives the case kit and the study PDFs.

canal.description: Where the class talks (e.g. 'canal da turma no Slack').

caso.description: The fictional case that runs through every lesson in mode estudo-dirigido. case-kit-builder turns it into an executable kit under material-alunos/<pasta>/.

descricao.description: What the fictional organization is and what flow the lessons look at.

pasta.description: Kit folder under material-alunos/ (default: 'caso-' + slug of nome).

componentes.description: Optional list of kit components the lessons need (data, tools, servers, hooks, scripts).

ementas.description: Syllabus files read by the general guide, relative to the output dir (default ['ementa.md']).

execucoes_reais.description: Mode estudo-dirigido: whether demo-recorder runs the demonstrations with the base tool and records the outputs (uses the instructor's account). When false, demonstrations ship marked as not rehearsed.

projeto.description: Final group-project definition. Consumed by the Phase-2 agents when tipo_avaliacao='projeto-pitch' (required in that mode). Ignored for 'repo-bugs'.

formato.description: Deliverable format in one phrase (e.g. 'Proposta executiva + pitch em vídeo').

descricao.description: Short statement of the project task the group must accomplish.

entregaveis.description: Concrete deliverables the group submits (e.g. deck, pitch video, peer-evaluation form). Non-empty.

duracao_assincrona_h.description: Asynchronous workload budget for the project, in hours.

marcos.description: Scaffolded checkpoints across the module (kickoff, mid-points, final mentoring).

aula.description: 1-based lesson number where this milestone happens.

rubrica.description: Instructor-facing grading criteria with weights. Weights should sum to 100.
